args: const net=require('node:net');function connect(host,port){return new Promise(r=>{let done=false;const s=net.connect({host,port});const end=v=>{if(done)return;done=true;s.destroy();r(v)};s.setTimeout(1500,()=>end(false));s.on('error',()=>end(false));s.on('connect',()=>end(true))})};(async()=>{const positive=await connect("172.18.0.1",8080);const mac=await connect('192.168.5.2',55062);const vm=await connect('192.168.5.1',55062);console.log(JSON.stringify({positive,mac,vm}));process.exit(positive&&!mac&&!vm?0:2)})()
